heroSubheadline: TABVAR distributes 100% of community donations into marine-grade 316 stainless steel hardware, glue-in anchors, and retrofitting for rock, ice, and mixed climbs across the Canadian Rockies.
heroImageAlt: Brian Spear on the First Ascent of Gift Card in Grotto Canyon
heroImageCaption: Brian Spear on the FA of Gift Card, protected by TABVAR-funded modern 316 stainless hardware.

pillars.title: 100% 316 Stainless Standard
pillars.description: Eliminating legacy plated steel. TABVAR subsidizes and distributes marine-grade 316 stainless and AustriAlpin glue-in bolts.

pillars.title: Active Issue Reporting
pillars.description: Encounter a spinning hanger or worn anchor? Report it directly on app.tabvar.org so local volunteers can inspect it.

pillars.title: 100% Volunteer Run
pillars.description: Zero administrative overhead. Board members volunteer their time so every dollar goes directly into drills, chains, bolts, and glue.

pillars.title: Hardware Subsidies
pillars.description: Funding new route development up to $2,250 for glue-ins, and unlimited reimbursement for replacing aging retrofits.

pillars.title: 15% Retail Partner Discounts
pillars.description: Super Donors ($100+) receive 15% discounts at MEC, Monod Sports, Vertical Addiction, Canmore Climbing Gym, and UnParallel.

pillars.title: The Golden Crowbar Award
pillars.description: Annual community celebration recognizing outstanding route development and retrofitting across the Bow Valley.

stewardshipCards.title: Precision Bolting on Rappel
stewardshipCards.description: Brian Spear drilling new sport lines on Grotto Canyon limestone, equipped with TABVAR-funded 316 stainless anchors.

stewardshipCards.title: Glue-In Resin Technology
stewardshipCards.description: TABVAR Director Tobias Link demonstrating proper epoxy extrusion and glue-in bolt seating for 50+ year anchor longevity.

stewardshipCards.title: Replacing Legacy Hardware
stewardshipCards.description: Volunteers replacing decades-old plated steel bolts with marine-grade 316 stainless wedge anchors and modern chain stations.

stewardshipCards.title: Routebuilder Training Clinics
stewardshipCards.description: Educating Bow Valley developers on safety standards, hole preparation, adhesive curing, and sustainable crag stewardship.
